title: Plan as Code Feedback Thread
description: Optional machine-readable projection of a PaC feedback thread, derived per SPEC Section 29.1. Markdown remains the canonical human-readable format. Feedback is append-only. Additional properties are permitted at the record level so repositories MAY extend records.

kind.description: Feedback item kind. Recommended values: Clarification, Decision, Report, Response, Confirmation. Repositories MAY use other values.
